parts.name: Cabinet Frame
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet frame is the main structural body of the storage cabinet, made of plywood panels forming the sides, back, and internal supports.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural integrity and support for the door, drawer, and base, ensuring the cabinet maintains its shape and stability.
parts.Movement_description: The frame is fixed and does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Cabinet Base
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet base is the bottom platform of the cabinet, made of plywood, supporting the entire structure and distributing weight evenly.
parts.Functional_description: It stabilizes the cabinet and prevents tipping, often resting directly on the floor or on adjustable feet.
parts.Movement_description: The base is stationary and does not move during use.

parts.name: Cabinet Door
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet door is a hinged wooden panel attached to the front of the cabinet, providing access to the internal storage space.
parts.Functional_description: It allows users to open and close the cabinet to store or retrieve items, often featuring a handle for easy operation.
parts.Movement_description: The door rotates about its hinges, swinging open and closed.

parts.name: Drawer
parts.Basic_description: The drawer is a rectangular compartment that slides in and out of the cabinet frame, typically located above the door section.
parts.Functional_description: It provides a smaller, easily accessible storage space for utensils, tools, or small items.
parts.Movement_description: The drawer moves linearly along metal or wooden slides, allowing it to be pulled out and pushed in smoothly.
